represent the containment of other elements without altering

There must be a special card called `Note` that allows the
capture of arbitrary text and annotates an existing node in the
model without modifying it or the model. The `Note` card must
have only one incoming link from the card it modifies.
Tools MUST be able to load one or more Aurora models from disk
for use in validation, editing, and rendering workflows.
Tools MUST validate Aurora models against the Aurora schema and
structural invariants, and report actionable diagnostics.
Tools MUST support updating Aurora models, including
creating, editing, and deleting cards and links while
Tools MUST persist Aurora models to disk in a stable,
text-based representation suitable for diffing and review.
Tools MUST generate human-readable views (e.g., Mermaid diagrams
and markdown) from an Aurora model.
Tools MUST be able to emit a compact, machine-friendly
representation of an Aurora model for agent consumption and
Tools MUST enable users to browse and search the cards and links
Tools MUST enable users to create, edit, and delete cards
and links with immediate feedback and without corrupting the
Tools MUST surface schema and invariant validation

Tools MUST provide a graph-based visualization of the model
and its relationships to support navigation and
Tools MUST allow users to preview and navigate the human-readable
Markdown renderings generated from an Aurora model.
Tools MUST integrate with the user’s workspace to open,
watch, and save model files using predictable,
Tools MUST perform file operations safely (prevent
unintended overwrites, constrain paths, and avoid writing
outside the user’s intended workspace locations).
Tools MUST respect workspace trust boundaries by limiting
potentially unsafe operations in untrusted workspaces.
Tools MUST render Markdown and any webview content safely by
sanitizing untrusted content and preventing script injection.
